_comment: Minimal smoke run for the OAT harness.
Cheapest possible config: SF=3, 1% batch 1, 0.001% batch 2, 0.002% batch 3,
two engines (spark + spark-openivm). Used by developers and CI dry-runs to
exercise the OAT loop, per-experiment cleanup, and artifact emission end-to-end
(results / logs / mount/oat-state/) without paying the full sf-sweep cost.
